articles.title: Samsung v. ZTE produced another landmark ruling: Supreme People’s Court of China denied intra-Chinese antisuit injunction
articles.description: The Supreme People's Court of China has published the denial of an intra-Chinese antisuit injunction Samsung sought against ZTE's patent enforcement in Chongqing. It's a landmark ruling and reveals ZTE had won a conditional injunction.

articles.title: Trump’s New Tariffs Hit Taiwan but Spare Its Chips. That’s Good News for TSMC and Apple
articles.description: Key TakeawaysWashington proposed tariffs of up to 15% on Taiwan, or up to 25% if talks fail. Taiwan’s notice exempts chips, smartphones, PCs and servers, the core of TSMC’s, Apple’s and Qualcomm’s businesses.

articles.title: How Qualcomm’s CMO is reshaping his team for its post-Apple era
articles.description: After losing a key partnership with Apple, U.S. chipmaker Qualcomm is shifting its focus to data centers and laptops. Its CMO, Don McGuire, is reshaping the company’s marketing strategy to support the transition.
